items.excerpt: Search Across Your Data - Cherre’s API allows you to retrieve data from every connected data set in a single query.
Large Data Pulls - Cherre’s API can sit on top of a BigQuery data warehouse, enabling you to pull thousands of records at a time
Geospatial Queries - The API offers out-of-the-box geospatial queries for all common PostGIS functions to power your custom searches.
Cherre can egress to your existing data warehouse, BI tools, deal management systems, valuation system, and more.
Define access controls for your agents, and ensure every interaction meets your security and compliance standards.
